item.title: What Makes One Person Stand up When Hate Becomes a Crowd?
item.description: On a street in Uttarakhand’s Kotdwar, a small confrontation unfolded in full public view. A small mob gathered around an elderly shopkeeper, questioning him over the name of his store, which had existed for decades. He remained seated through the exchange.
